context: Two friends compare hiking experiences on steep slopes
purpose: Teach: 羽/脚/坂/食い/漏れ/流さ/精度/実習

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: この前の坂、まじで脚にきたわ。
lines.en: That slope the other day really wrecked my legs.
lines.style: Casual male university student, relaxed and slightly tired tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: わかる、羽でも生えてないと無理だよあれ。
lines.en: I know, you'd need wings to climb that thing.
lines.style: Energetic teenage boy, joking exaggerated complaint tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 途中で水が漏れててさ、ボトルから全部流された。
lines.en: Halfway up my bottle leaked and everything spilled out.
lines.style: Casual male university student, mildly exasperated storytelling tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 最悪じゃん。俺は地図の精度が悪くて道に迷ったよ。
lines.en: That sucks. My map was so inaccurate I got lost.
lines.style: Teen boy, sympathetic then pivoting to his own complaint.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 学校の実習で行った山も結構きつかったけどな。
lines.en: The mountain we climbed for school practicum was tough too.
lines.style: University student reflecting, comparative reminiscing tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: そんなとこ登るの？腹減って食いもん全部なくなりそう。
lines.en: You climb places like that? I'd run out of snacks.
lines.style: Teen boy, surprised and hungry-sounding playful tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ほんとだよ、下山する頃にはヘトヘトでさ。
lines.en: Seriously, by the time we came down we were drained.
lines.style: University student, weary but warm reminiscent tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 次は一緒に行こうよ、絶対楽しいって。
lines.en: Let's go together next time, it'll definitely be fun.
lines.style: Teen boy, bright and inviting enthusiastic tone.
